user.title: Connect to Cointra Electric
user.description: Enter the same credentials you use in the COINTRA ELECTRIC app.

ips.title: Local IP of each radiator (optional)
ips.description: If you know the local IP of each radiator on your network (for example, with a DHCP reservation), enter it so its real availability can be checked by ping every 5 minutes. Leave the field blank if you don't know it or don't want this check for that radiator.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Cointra Electric
reauth_confirm.description: The password for account {username} is no longer valid. Enter the current password to keep using the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Cointra server

init.title: Cointra Electric options
init.description: Adjust the refresh interval against the Cointra cloud and, optionally, each radiator's local IP so its real availability can be checked by ping every 5 minutes.
